title: Dental Mega Dataset
subtitle: 10,171 intraoral X-ray images for dental disease detection
description: Merged dataset from Kaggle (oral-disease, dental-radiography, tooth-dataset) and Roboflow (dental_yolo_v8-420). 5 classes: Caries, Crown, Filling, Implant, Periapical-lesion. YOLO format with train/valid/test splits.
